trustedSliderDrag._note: Real CDP pointer drags (Input.dispatchMouseEvent) on the lil-gui log slider track — NOT synthetic PointerEvents. This is the drag-profile the prior AC never exercised (it only drove state.planetRadiusEarth + applyDrivers programmatically).
trustedSliderDrag.mechanism: drag FROM the .lil-slider element TO injected drop-targets at 1/4 and 3/4 track x (1/2 = drag to the slider's own centre). lil-gui's pointerdown+window pointermove path registered each drag.
trustedSliderDrag.result: monotonic increase 0.80 -> 2.10 -> 5.76 RE across the track; the real pointer-drag reliably moves the radius up (addresses the UAT 'does not reliably go up' complaint at the pointer-capture layer). Log map gives a usable, non-violent response across the whole 0.3-16 span.
